answer: My memory doesn't hold that answer. It only records that a sudo password was used once for an inotify sysctl, and that you were told to rotate it. It doesn't say which file persists the setting across reboots, or what limit was set. I won't guess at a path or a number. Checking on obelisk would settle it: `sysctl fs.inotify.max_user_watches` shows the live value, and `grep -r inotify /etc/sysctl.conf /etc/sysctl.d/` shows which file sets it.
